_huong_dan.1_muc_dich: FILE NAY LA NGUON DU LIEU DUY NHAT de cap nhat website. Sua xong thi luu file, tai lai trang la xong. Khong can sua index.html.
_huong_dan.2_cach_mo: Mo file =chuot phai > Open with > Notepad (hoac mo bang Visual Studio Code). Sau khi sua, kiem tra bang https://jsonformatter.org de tranh loi dau phay / dau nhay kep.
_huong_dan.3_may_chu: Khi chay tren GitHub Pages, trang se doc file nay. Khi mo index.html truc tiep bang file:// trinh duyen chan doc file nen trang dung ban sao nhung trong index.html - vi vay phai tai (commit) ca file index.html lan data/content.json.
_huong_dan.4_ky_tu_tieng_viet: Giu nguyen bo dau tieng Viet, luu file voi ma hoa UTF-8.
_huong_dan.5_khong_duoc_lam: Khong them dau phay o phan tu cuoi danh sach; khong viet ghi chu // trong file JSON; khong dung dau nhay kep trong noi dung (dung dau nhay don va ke tu dau nhay).
